details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It ships a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and a catch-all Proxy shim in index.js that also fires the beacon when the module is required, so any install or import of the name reports back. The beacon sends a JSON POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header; the body contains only the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory and the npm/node version string. It reads no environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents, and drops nothing on disk. The package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed.
